items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: I used to go to lessons a time when I, teach him home... How long did you take lessons from Professor Shalini? Almost a year.

ctx.x: Well, who did you take lessons from?
Oh, no. Old man by the name of Shalini. He was a letter carrier.
